decision_rules.when: The invoice is not in GSTR-2B
decision_rules.detail: The government record does not confirm the supplier reported it.

decision_rules.when: GSTR-2B marks the ITC as not available
decision_rules.detail: The invoice is listed but the credit is not allowed yet.

decision_rules.when: The purchase is in a blocked category
decision_rules.detail: For example motor vehicles, food, club membership, construction or personal use.

decision_rules.when: The claim time limit has passed
decision_rules.detail: Credit must be claimed by 30 November after the financial year of the invoice.

decision_rules.when: Your books show more tax than GSTR-2B
decision_rules.detail: Only the amount in GSTR-2B is claimable. The extra is at risk.

decision_rules.when: Everything above is clear and the invoice matches
decision_rules.detail: Invoice is in GSTR-2B with the same amount.

decision_rules.when: No rule passage is found for the case
decision_rules.detail: The tool never guesses a rule. It holds the credit and asks you to check with your CA.
